name: Siltcoil Matriarch

provenance.brief: Original armored limbless crawler with a serial axial hierarchy, independent jaw, phase-shifted body locomotion and a preparation clip. Body contact is declared; no foot-contact fidelity claim.

design_rationale: An axial, limbless silt-filtering matriarch has overlapping ceramic segments and an opening sieve jaw. Serial motion and an unusual body plan are the lessons; it has no copied wings, encounter poison animation or reference anatomy.
